The selected BASIC recipebuild decision · A-074

Replace Cloak of Summer’s End (level 36) with The Queen of Rot, choose its Nearly Complete: Insightful Constitution +7, and fill the previously empty Green socket on Legendary Ring of Unnatural Accuracy with Diamond of Spot +22 (Colorless augment, ML36). All other selected equipment and crafts stay the same. Keep the Resistance +12 augment even though the model uses the Queen’s native +13 instead. Calamitous and Sinew remain the two bow options above; offhand stays empty.

Slots and levels. There are 33 sockets: 24 ordinary + 9 Sun/Moon; 28 filled. The five empty ordinary sockets are Compass Colorless, Queen Yellow, Claws Green, Coldlight Colorless and Battlerager Green. Every Solar and Lunar Gem in the table is the Legendary version. The nine Solar and Lunar Gems, Viktranium crafts, Nearly Complete and Sealed in Undeath are separate fills, not innate finished-item effects. Both filled bows and the complete outfit require level 36. The quiver has no sockets. Spot +22 is an Enhancement source; it does not promise a final +22 skill increase or a successful trap check. Its acquisition route is unknown; no vendor is assumed.

Source limits. The Queen’s ML35, binding, sockets, named effects and explicit Insightful Constitution +7 option were relayed from a normal Wiki page observation around 00:07 UTC on 9 November 2026. The reported footer was 19 September 2026, Update 81.3, with logged-out caching up to 12 hours. Original capture bytes, an exact revision permalink and every tooltip bonus type were not retained here. Acquisition and quest-pack routes use retained infobox harvests; not every quest page was freshly opened. The A-074 record distinguishes that relay, prior retained item evidence and the study report; none is a new local optimizer run or an in-game check.

reviewed_replacements.before: Layer 3: the hit does less. Physical Resistance Rating reduces physical damage by 100/(100+PRR) (PRR page): 20 PRR takes a sixth off, 50 takes a third, 100 takes half. Each point is about +1% effective hit points. Light armor gives PRR equal to your Base Attack Bonus with proficiency, which Ranger has; the rest is items. Magical Resistance Rating does the same for fire, cold, electric, acid, sonic, force, light, negative and the rest (MRR page), capped at 100 in light armor. Survivalist adds +3 PRR; the Divine epic past lives add up to +36; the Reaper tree’s Grim Barricade adds more. The fully filled level-36 kit contributes 132 gear PRR; the whole-character defense totals remain unverified. At level 10 you have perhaps 20 PRR, which cuts physical damage by a sixth. That gap is why levelling hurts.

reviewed_replacements.before: Ranking used for the current kit (bundle INTiana Jones Salt, 31 October 2026). Intelligence, Ranged Power, Doubleshot, Seeker, Armor-Piercing, Physical Sheltering (Max 132), Constitution, Sneak Attack Dice (Min 2), Dodge (Max 23), Will Save, Distant Diversion, Fortification, Reflex Save, Fortitude Save, False Life, Deadly, Magical Sheltering, Healing Amplification, Accuracy, Legendary Salt (Min 1), Immunity to Fear, True Seeing, Blindness Immunity, Dexterity; crafting and augments allowed, Ranged Alacrity dropped from the list (same bonus type as the Haste SLA), the Legendary Calamitous Longbow pinned as the weapon. The order is a statement of what the build refuses to trade: the four offence ceilings first, because nothing competes with them; then the two lines whose ceilings compete for slots (Armor-Piercing’s Artifact gem against Intelligence’s, Physical Sheltering’s set against the necklace), ordered by what Reaper punishes most; then the survivability block; then the cheap wins, placed at the bottom so they can only use slots nothing above wants. Four test solves led here. (4) Calamitous pinned: the same twelve items with the full eight-stack Salt on the bow’s Woeful slot (the Horn augment is the one-stack version, Dinosaur Bone crafting page).
